@Antoine Chambert-Loir, @Heather Macbeth, and I are organizing a two week workshop at the Simons Foundation, June 16-27, 2025, on "Lean for Mathematicians" (thanks to Jeremy for helping us with the name). There is more info on the website:

https://sites.google.com/view/simonsleanworkshop2025

including a link to the application form. Week 1 (June 16-20th) is devoted to training PhD students and postdocs on formalization; for week 2 (June 23-27th), participants from week 1 are joined by senior researchers for talks and projects at a more advanced level. Applications submitted before Feb 7th will receive full consideration. Please help spread the word, and encourage your colleagues to apply!
Are the applications still being evaluated? Is there already a decision in sight? I'm asking because I need to make travel plans.

Sorry, we received about 100 applications for 30 slots; we're still working through the files but hope to be able to make decisions by the end of the week. (And the Simons Foundation will be arranging all travel directly...)
